title: Graduation Scholarships

provider.name: International Office of TU Dresden (Financed by the STIBET-Programme of the DAAD)

summary: Financial support for highly qualified international students at TU Dresden completing their diploma, bachelor, master, or state exam degree within one year.

degree_levels.notes: International students of TU Dresden on the level of a diploma, bachelor, master or state exam student.

subject_areas.notes: All subjects at TU Dresden are eligible.

nationality.notes: International students; students with multiple nationalities where one is German are NOT eligible.

residence.notes: Students must be enrolled during the funding period and not permanently stay outside their place of study.

mandatory.text: International student at TU Dresden in diploma, bachelor, master, or state exam program
Average grade of at least 2.5 achieved so far
Successful completion of studies expected within one year (completed by March 31 of following year for summer applications, or September 30 for winter applications)
At least 45% of the credits for the entire degree program completed OR thesis already registered
No income from paid employment or state social benefits above EUR 634 gross/month
No other scholarships during the funding period
No graduation scholarship awarded before/during the funding period
Enrolled during the funding period and not permanently staying outside place of study

exceptions.text: Stays abroad are only possible within the framework of a compulsory stay according to study regulations; in case of leaves of absence, written proof must be provided by examination office/faculty that a degree is still possible within a semester of leave.

funding.description: EUR 300 per month for a maximum of 3 months.
funding.duration: 3 months (maximum until deadline for submission of final thesis)

application_rounds.notes: 1 February until 18 March for the funding period 1 April - 30 September (summer semester)
1 August until 8 September for the funding period 1 October - 31 March (winter semester)

recurring_deadline_notes: Summer semester deadline: 1 February until 18 March. Winter semester deadline: 1 August until 8 September.

required_documents.text: Application form for a STIBET Scholarship
Certificate of enrollment for the funding period
Current list of examination results (transcript) issued by the examination office
Confirmation of the examination office stating the achieved credits as well as the overall average grade

steps.text: Send complete application documents exclusively in digital form (PDF documents named Last name_First name, max. 10 MB) by the application deadline.

sources.title: Scholarship- and Mentoring Programme (DAAD-STIBET) — Studies — TU Dresden
sources.notes: Provides student funding for international students physically studying for a degree in Germany.
